items: Animals are no longer sausages: a body can have a deep, wide chest and a slim waist (its width and depth set apart along its length), and a spine of its own along its back, from a crest to a groove. The big cats and the wolf carry a groove between their back muscles, the stag and elk a shoulder line, the boar a bristled crest; the fox, fennec and roe have their new girth
